briefing: One manifest, one Transporter, one Asp Mk II marked for destruction. Carry the first, guard the second, finish the third.
I am {PATRON}, colonel of the state guard at {HERE}. The state pays for a job finished, not for one attempted.
Take the contract or leave the dock. I will not ask twice.
dossier.lead: {PATRON} has orders waiting at {WORLD}, and no patience for a pilot who lingers.

manifest.arrive: Take the manifest to {TARGET}. Payment on delivery: {PAY}
manifest.fail: The manifest failed to reach {TARGET}. No payment

guard.fail: The escort failed before {TARGET}. Contract closed

wreck.arrive: Scoop the Transporter's wreckage adrift at {TARGET} for {PAY}
wreck.success: Cargo recovered from the wreck at {TARGET}
wreck.fail: The wreck at {TARGET} was lost. No recovery

purge.arrive: Find and destroy the Asp last seen at {TARGET} for {PAY}
purge.success: The Asp is dealt with. File closed
purge.fail: The Asp slipped free of {TARGET}. Contract closed

dossier.title: Colonel Adalwyn's Convoy

rumour.far: Word on the board says the state guard at {WORLD} is hiring pilots for the colonel's convoy.
rumour.near: {PATRON} sends word: report to {WORLD} before the manifest waits for someone else.

dossier.news: The state guard at {WORLD} confirms {PATRON} is contracting pilots for convoy duty.

story.opening: On day {DAY} the commander took the colonel's contract at {WORLD}.

closing.complete: The Asp fell silent near {WORLD}, and the colonel's contract closed clean on day {DAY}.
closing.fail: The contract collapsed near {WORLD} on day {DAY}, and the colonel filed no thanks.

manifest.success: The manifest reached {WORLD} on day {DAY}, delivered as ordered.
manifest.failed: The manifest never reached {WORLD}; the deadline broke on day {DAY}.

guard.success: The Transporter reached station range at {WORLD} on day {DAY}, the escort held.
guard.targetDestroyed: The Transporter was destroyed near {WORLD} on day {DAY}, the escort broken.
guard.targetEscaped: The Transporter jumped clear of {WORLD} on day {DAY}, lost from the escort's sight.
guard.failed: The escort collapsed near {WORLD}; the deadline broke on day {DAY}.

wreck.success: The commander scooped the Transporter's cargo adrift at {WORLD} on day {DAY}.
wreck.targetDestroyed: The canister was destroyed before the scoop near {WORLD} on day {DAY}.
wreck.failed: The wreck at {WORLD} slipped away before day {DAY} closed the deadline.

purge.targetDestroyed: The Asp Mk II was destroyed near {WORLD} on day {DAY}, the colonel's order done.
purge.targetEscaped: The Asp Mk II jumped clear of {WORLD} on day {DAY}, unfinished business for the state.
purge.targetFled: The Asp Mk II fled {WORLD} on day {DAY}, running rather than fighting.
purge.failed: The hunt for the Asp died near {WORLD}; the deadline broke on day {DAY}.
